_comment: NEEDS_NEW_DSL: 'If this is DEFENDED BY an action card, this gets +2{p}' asks about the cards defending THIS attack, which needs a condition over combat.defending_cards by type. ability_type corrected to TRIGGERED/ON_ATTACK so it is reachable, but with no such condition the gate is absent and the buff would apply unconditionally — left ungated deliberately rather than faked with an invented flag.
